global_scene_rules.opening_establishment_rule: The first meaningful choice may not appear until the player knows who they are, where they are, when it is, and what pressure is already active.
global_scene_rules.choice_callback_rule: Every meaningful choice must have an immediate readable callback or a named later echo requirement.
global_scene_rules.first_appearance_rule: Every major character, location, prop, and special term must be introduced in the path where the player first encounters it.
global_scene_rules.segment_rhythm_rule: Final writing should display one playable beat per segment: narration sentence, dialogue line, phone message, hint, or memory log.

scenes.scene_objective: Establish the player role, place, time pressure, and first emotional hook.
scenes.intention_function: Show the core conflict in miniature: the player wants to avoid a decision, but the world makes avoidance costly.
scenes.player_context: The player has just started the game and knows nothing yet.
scenes.current_pressure: A scheduled event is about to begin, and a personal promise is already overdue.

active_characters.immediate_want: Get through the evening without confronting the old promise.
active_characters.blocking_force: Messages, objects, and other characters keep pulling the promise back into the present.
active_characters.player_facing_entry: Use first-person narration; do not show the protagonist portrait in first-person mode.

scenes.conflict: The player wants to avoid a decision, but the scene produces evidence that avoidance is no longer possible.
scenes.turn: By the end, the player understands the immediate goal and why ignoring it has a cost.

visual_novel_triad.narrative: The player understands identity, place, time pressure, and the first emotional hook.
visual_novel_triad.presentation: Background, prop evidence, narration box, and right-top hint make the pressure legible.
visual_novel_triad.interactivity: The next choice will ask the player how to respond to the pressure they just understood.

required_visible_evidence: important prop is visible or described
branch_information_boundary: No later node may assume a character name or term that has not appeared in the current route.

setup_payoff_links.payoff: The first choice forces the player to respond to that pressure.

acceptance_criteria: A player can answer who/where/when/why before the first choice.
The scene has a visible or textual turn rather than only exposition.
